title: Chrome Bullet Lighter 2016 Novelty Ammo Style Refillable Lighter - Untested
descriptionText:
Pre owned condition. Shows surface scratches, scuffs, and finish wear consistent with use. Please review all photos for exact cosmetic condition.

Novelty chrome bullet shaped lighter marked “LIGHTER BULLET 2016” on the base.
This lighter is designed to resemble a large caliber ammunition round and separates into two pieces to access the internal lighter mechanism. Chrome finish with smooth bullet tip design. Refillable but functionality has not been tested and is not guaranteed.
Sold as a collectible novelty lighter.
Features
Bullet style novelty lighter
Chrome metal finish
Marked LIGHTER BULLET 2016 on base
Two piece design
Refillable type
Condition notes
Cosmetic wear present including scratches and small marks
Interior shows typical residue from use
Ignition not tested
